notes: Committee-referral debate. The chair addresses each senator by name in a one-line turn of her own, so short chair turns alternate with senators' replies. Two dashes inside Pinedo's speech are horizontal-bar characters used as parenthetical marks mid-sentence ('despacho─obviamente'), not stenographer lines.
